lead: A `cargo-named` acceptance check can report a test red that passes on every re-run, and the driver's own overlapped release prebuild is why.
body: `nvs-server`'s `serve` tests bind real loopback sockets and hold a connection to a memory ceiling, so they are timing-sensitive, and a check run while `cargo build --release` saturates the machine can miss a frame that arrives every other time. Before treating a red *named* test as the regression that outranks your item, run that one test and then its whole crate suite — if both pass, it was load and the ledger's next line will not repeat it. See `tools/nv/accept/accept.ts`.
